cc:Work.dc:title: Integration ownership and bounded collaboration
cc:Work.dc:description: The user talks primarily to the integration owner. Bidirectional blue connections show task assignment and result feedback. The owner coordinates bounded tasks and targeted review. Workers share current state and artifacts, and communicate directly for a specific dependency. Shared runtime resources require coordination.
